title: Reconcile public documentation and honest claims
summary: Public-facing documentation has been reconciled with the actual implementation state. README.md now carries an experimental preview warning, documents the three split packages (namtor, namtor-gnome, namtor-kde) for Arch/Fedora/Debian, describes the Settings-only setup flow, per-service PAM opt-in, TPM fallback warning, bundled permissive models, notices/source availability, and the WITHHELD gates list. packaging/README.md carries the experimental preview warning, documents the split package names, and replaces the stale NAMTOR_ACCEPT_LICENCE env var reference with the typed admission policy description. HANDOFF.md carries the experimental preview warning and updated state (M10 implemented, split packages, Settings-only flow). docs/evidence/status-audit.md has the stale NAMTOR_ACCEPT_LICENCE env var reference removed from the owner-gated inputs table. COPYING.md has the stale NAMTOR_ACCEPT_LICENCE reference replaced with the typed admission policy description. The doc audit test verifies 25 checks: 11 stale-string absences, 3 experimental preview warnings present, 3 package-name documentations, 3 distro package manager commands, and 5 link-resolution checks. All pass.
